cohort_acceptance: All three predefined periods must independently pass the unchanged 0.2.5 research quality gate. No replacement attempts or selection of passing windows. Do not pool costs if any period fails.
idle_sleep_inhibition: Run under macOS caffeinate -i. This does not establish protection against forced sleep or clock changes.
limitations: Three nearby short windows are correlated and do not establish market-regime coverage, realized fill quality, strategy profitability or live readiness. No historical cost substitution.
